name: ux-builder
description: Theme tokens and widgets shared by the AI agent harness and the products embedded in it.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ux-builder/tokens && npm run build --workspace @ux-builder/ui
scripts.verify: node tools/verify-equivalence.mjs && node tools/diff-resolved.mjs tools/fixtures/resolved-0.3.0 packages/tokens/dist/resolved
scripts.check: npm run schemas && npm run lint && node tools/gen-catalogue.mjs --check && npm run rules && npm run coverage && npm test && npm run build && npm run licences && npm run test:built && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/tokens && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/ui && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/create-app && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/mcp && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/audit && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/visuals && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/trace && npm test --workspace @ux-builder/design && npm run verify && npm run contrast && npm run gallery && npm run gallery -- --brand tests/fixtures/brands/sample.brand.json
scripts.storybook: npm run build && npm run storybook --workspace @ux-builder/ui
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build && npm run build-storybook --workspace @ux-builder/ui
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && node tools/gen-catalogue.mjs
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e --workspace @ux-builder/theme-builder && npm run test:e2e --workspace @ux-builder/create-app
